content: Opening up Spokehaven Cycle Works now, already a queue forming. I signed the delivery slip as Jonas Heller, Owner Manager, so we are clear to start the day.
Priya Nair is leading the repair benches through this morning's backlog. Dario Venn is out back getting the hire bikes ready, so point any hire questions his way.
Lena Frost is covering the front till Saturday and Sunday for us. Ellis Grant is looking over the accounts this afternoon, so please leave any receipts in the drawer.
Morning, Harold Pike, our landlord, stopped by about the leaky back door. And Mara Quinn is coming Thursday to look at winter budgets, she helps me think through the business side.
Quick house rules for you: write all times in 24-hour clock, limit status summaries to three bullets, and ask before emailing Northwind Cycle Parts.
Can you chase Northwind Cycle Parts on those derailleurs? We get most of our parts through them. Gripline Tire Co. also shorted us two touring tires again.
Brighthelm Safety Gear dropped off the new helmet display, they supply all our helmets. Pedalbrew Coffee Cart is running late today, but they usually handle coffee for our Saturday rides.
Morning, could you file the autumn servicing jobs under OVERHAUL-2026-A and the extra hire bikes paperwork under RENTAL-EXPAND-07? Swamped at the stand today.
Quick one between customers, the customer bike storage for winter is logged as STORE-WINTER-11, and I ring the parts vendors Tuesdays at 10:30. Give me a nudge before.
Also we sort shifts with the team Mondays at 09:00, and I go over the ledgers with the bookkeeper Thursdays at 11:00. Thanks for keeping me straight.
Can you put the staff rota meeting on the calendar for 2026-10-26 at 09:00?
Hey, can you nudge the crew that we count everything in the back Fridays at 16:00, and the boxes from the distributor land Wednesdays at 08:45? Today got hectic.
Also flag that the hire bikes roll in Saturdays at 07:30, and I am catching up with the building owner First Mondays 14:00. Remind me Thursday please?
One more thing, we need all the fall tune-ups wrapped by 2026-11-15 and the bigger hire fleet ready by 2026-12-01. It's a busy week.
Morning, could you leave the repair queue in Bay One where we do servicing, and check the spare frames locked in Unit Shed B for storage? Busy today.
Rentals today are signed out at Front Counter A, and the extra stock is piled in Back Room 2 as overflow. Can you update both lists?
Quick heads-up, the joint event we're doing with the neighboring town is in Kestrel Harbor, and our parts orders ship from Norcross Village where the supplier is based.
For checkouts we follow this order: confirm booking ID, inspect tires and brakes, photograph bike condition, collect deposit and signature, then log checkout in Wheelbook.
Morning, Old Bessie was wobbling during the wheel true, that stand is getting tired. And Puffy Dragon kept cutting out, so that compressor will need a look this afternoon if you have time.
I put today's bookings into Wheelbook Pro, that's our booking system. I'll close yesterday's receipts in Ledgerline Daily, that's what we use for the accounts.
Please save the signed rental contracts to /spokehaven/rentals/agreements where we keep them, and upload today's job pictures to /spokehaven/repairs/photos2026 for the repairs.
Could you drop a note in #spokehaven-crew for the whole crew, and check in with the rentals team in #rentals-desk when you have a minute?
Running between jobs today, try our head mechanic on Ext 201, or the front desk on Ext 202 if you need anything.
Please add a task to prepare OVERHAUL-2026-A parts order.
Could you try the workshop phone on Ext 203, and please keep parts spending under 4,000 euros for this month?
Morning, could you note we still collect 150 euros as a deposit on rentals? And the full strip-down in the workshop is 89 euros, just in case customers ask this afternoon.
Between jobs I'm sorting posters for Marlow Bay VeloFest coming up this autumn, and we need to set aside tools for support at Harbor Lights Ride for charity next week.
Can you check if the Carrier Moose X2 cargo runabout is back from its test ride? And please log the battery swap under EB-FLEET-09 for the hire fleet.
What's on the calendar for 2026-10-28?

Could you chase Ironclasp Locks Ltd. about the late delivery? They make the locks we stock. Also see if Tidy Spokes Crew can come in early tomorrow, they handle our cleaning and the back room needs it after Saturday.

Volta Fixers should be back this afternoon to check the shutters, they look after our electrics so let them in if I'm out. Harborcover Insurance sent the renewal forms, they arrange our cover, please remind me to sign before Friday.

The council wants a copy of the unit paperwork, it's filed under LEASE-MB-44, that's our agreement for the Marlow Bay shop. And for the next key order quote ACC-7741-NW, that's our number with them so it doesn't get held up.
Morning, quick note before the rush — for ordering tires use ACC-3390-GL at checkout, and remind the crew we're on Split Shifts Daily this week.
Heads up, we're getting ready for Autumn Velo Season, so please make sure Blue Mule is fueled up for the afternoon drop-offs.
Jonah Reed just stopped by the shop, said he'd be back tomorrow for a tune-up, so keep his file handy.
Can you remind me what I said earlier today about the rental assistant name?
